# Movoa AI Video Prompts

Unlimited AI video generator with sound: on paid plans the tenth take of a shot costs what the first did, and your first clip is free to make right now. This package puts tested text-to-video and photo-to-video prompt templates with camera movement and synchronized sound cues one trigger away, so you can paste a complete shot description into [Movoa](https://movoa.ai/?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package) or any video generator without rewriting audio and lens direction from scratch.

### Installation

```bash
espanso install movoa-video-prompts
```

### Usage

| Trigger | Expands to |
|---|---|
| `:mvshot` | Rain-lit street tracking shot with rainfall and footsteps audio |
| `:mvphoto` | Subtle photo-to-video push-in preserving face and lighting |
| `:mvcartoon` | 2D cel-shaded cartoon clip prompt with dialogue and foley cues |
| `:mvdialogue` | Over-the-shoulder two-character cafe dialogue scene |
| `:mvproduct` | 180-degree studio product turntable shot with crisp sound cues |
| `:mvestablishing` | Golden-hour aerial establishing shot with coastal soundscape |
| `:mvaction` | Stabilized handheld action follow shot with foley cues |
| `:mvfood` | Slow-motion macro coffee pour with rich kitchen audio |

Quick link triggers:

| Trigger | Expands to |
|---|---|
| `:movoa` | [movoa.ai](https://movoa.ai/?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package) |
| `:mvpricing` | [Movoa Pricing](https://movoa.ai/pricing?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package) |
| `:mvdocs` | [Movoa Docs](https://movoa.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) |

### Why structured audio cues matter

Every prompt includes explicit camera framing, subject motion, and synchronized sound cues (dialogue, foley, and room tone) so multi-shot stories hold consistent visual and audio style across retakes. Try your first clip with sound directly at [Movoa](https://movoa.ai/?utm_source=espanso&utm_medium=package).
